translations.EN: That is not really how I swing.
translations.TL: Hindi talaga ganoon ang hilig ko.

translations.EN: I do not lean that way, just so you know.
translations.TL: Hindi ako ganoon magkainteres, para alam mo lang.

translations.EN: Not my preference, but thanks for being open.
translations.TL: Hindi ko gusto ang ganoon, pero salamat sa pagiging tapat.

translations.EN: I appreciate the honesty, but that is not for me.
translations.TL: Salamat sa katapatan, pero hindi 'yan para sa akin.

translations.EN: That is not my type of thing.
translations.TL: Hindi ko tipo ang ganyang bagay.

translations.EN: Just so we are clear, I do not look at you that way.
translations.TL: Para malinaw sa atin, hindi kita tinitingnan sa ganoong paraan.

translations.EN: I am not interested in that kind of arrangement.
translations.TL: Hindi ako interesado sa ganyang uri ng ugnayan.

translations.EN: Fair enough, but that is not my direction.
translations.TL: Nirerespeto ko, pero hindi 'yan ang patutunguhan ko.

translations.EN: I keep things strictly platonic here.
translations.TL: Hanggang magkaibigan lang talaga ako rito.

translations.EN: Good to know where you stand, but I do not swing that way.
translations.TL: Mabuting malaman ang panig mo, pero hindi ganoon ang akin.

translations.EN: I prefer to keep things simple between us.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kong panatilihing simple ang lahat sa pagitan natin.

translations.EN: Let us just keep this uncomplicated.
translations.TL: Panatilihin na lang nating hindi magulo ito.

translations.EN: Survival is messy enough without adding that.
translations.TL: Magulo na ang kaligtasan para dagdagan pa niyan.

translations.EN: I like where we are at. Let us not complicate it.
translations.TL: Gusto ko kung nasaan tayo ngayon. Huwag na nating guluhin.

translations.EN: We work best when things stay straightforward.
translations.TL: Mas maayos tayong nagtutulungan kapag diretso lang ang usapan.

translations.EN: I am not looking for anything complicated out here.
translations.TL: Hindi ako naghahanap ng anumang kumplikado dito.

translations.EN: Simple is safe. Let us keep it that way.
translations.TL: Ligtas kapag simple. Panatilihin nating ganoon.

translations.EN: I value this partnership too much to make it awkward.
translations.TL: Masyadong mahalaga ang samahan natin para gawing asiwa.

translations.EN: Let us stay focused on staying alive instead.
translations.TL: Magpokus na lang tayo sa pananatiling buhay.

translations.EN: Keeping it clear and simple works best for both of us.
translations.TL: Mas maganda para sa ating dalawa kung malinaw at simple lang.
